messages.content: Can the airline get Marcus, Daniel, and Owen together on the outbound without changing the Thursday flight? The Monday seats are already fine, so leave those alone.

Is there any way an agent can override the map and put all three of us together for free? Owen is 12.

The agent can request family seating, but they cannot confirm three together before departure because no qualifying block is open. They could leave the pair and aisle assignment in place and ask the gate agent to try again, but the result would depend on seats opening that day. The confirmed adjacent option remains row 26 for $96 total.

Take the paid row. Put me on the aisle, Owen in the middle, and Daniel at the window. Do not change either flight or the return seats.

Before I finalize: the outbound paid assignments will be Marcus 26D, Owen 26E, and Daniel 26F for $96 total. The Thursday and Monday nonstops stay unchanged, and the return remains Daniel 21D, Owen 21E, and Marcus 21F. Proceed?
